Before you call

Is it safe to drive?

Three quick checks that tell you what to do next.

Tap the light you see on your dash. We'll tell you what it usually means and whether to drive in or stop.

  • Check engine (steady)

    Usually a sensor or emissions part. Safe to drive in; book this week.

    Diagnose it
  • Check engine (flashing)

    Active misfire. Stop driving and call — this damages the catalytic converter fast.

    Call (907) 555-0187
  • Brake / ABS

    Brake fluid low, worn pads, or an ABS sensor. Drive gently and book today.

    Check brakes
  • Temperature

    Overheating risk. Pull over if the needle climbs. Call before restarting.

    Call (907) 555-0187

This is general guidance, not a diagnosis. The code reader tells us where to start.

Tell us when and where. We'll name the two most likely causes.

What does it sound like?

Plan your morning so the car is checked first and you're back at work by nine.

  • 7:30 am — Drop the keys in the box or hand them at the counter. Tell us the complaint and when it happens.
  • 8:30–9:30 am — We check your complaint first. You get a call or text with what we found, a photo, and a price.
  • Your yes — Nothing else happens until you say go. If a part needs ordering, we tell you how long.
